senses.en: This sedan chair is what I use to carry a (passenger).

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.325–326，xuma 條下派生詞

senses.zh: 你娶個好妻子，就會好，有好家庭
senses.en: When you get a good wife, you will be fine with a good family.

senses.en: Awi was going to build a house here.

senses.en: This land is to build a house.
This house was built by us (exc.).

records.text: nahada tubabaw a sapatuxuma ka riak

senses.zh: 有較高的地方可以蓋房子
senses.en: There was a higher place to build a house.
I shall build a house here.
